mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.merchant_id, s.store_id, s.category_id, c.category_name, s.service_name, s.description, s.price, s.duration_minutes, s.fulfillment_type, s.cover_asset_id, s.status FROM service_item s LEFT JOIN service_category c ON c.id = s.category_id WHERE s.id = #{serviceId}

SELECT s.id, s.merchant_id, s.store_id, s.category_id, c.category_name, s.service_name, s.description, s.price, s.duration_minutes, s.fulfillment_type, s.cover_asset_id, s.status FROM service_item s LEFT JOIN service_category c ON c.id = s.category_id WHERE s.store_id = #{storeId} AND s.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY s.created_at DESC, s.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM service_item s WHERE s.store_id = #{storeId} AND s.status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT s.id, s.merchant_id, s.store_id, s.category_id, c.category_name, s.service_name, s.description, s.price, s.duration_minutes, s.fulfillment_type, s.cover_asset_id, s.status FROM service_item s LEFT JOIN service_category c ON c.id = s.category_id WHERE s.status = 'ACTIVE'
AND s.category_id = #{categoryId}
AND (s.service_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '\\' OR c.category_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '\\')
ORDER BY s.id ASC
ORDER BY s.merchant_id ASC, s.store_id ASC, s.id ASC

SELECT c.id, c.category_code, p.category_code AS parent_code, c.category_name, c.icon_url, c.description, c.sort_no, c.status FROM service_category c LEFT JOIN service_category p ON p.id = c.parent_id WHERE c.status = 'ENABLED' ORDER BY c.sort_no ASC, c.id ASC

SELECT c.id, c.category_code, p.category_code AS parent_code, c.category_name, c.icon_url, c.description, c.sort_no, c.status FROM service_category c LEFT JOIN service_category p ON p.id = c.parent_id WHERE c.category_code = #{categoryCode}

SELECT s.category_id, s.store_id, COUNT(*) AS service_count FROM service_item s INNER JOIN service_category c ON c.id = s.category_id WHERE s.status = 'ACTIVE' AND c.status = 'ENABLED' GROUP BY s.category_id, s.store_id
SELECT DISTINCT s.store_id FROM service_item s WHERE s.category_id = #{categoryId} AND s.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY s.store_id ASC
